articles.title: 49ers top Cardinals to reach 3-0, but lose Mike Evans, Trent Williams to injuries
articles.description: Evans left with a rib injury and Trent Williams exited with a stinger in the 49ers' 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
